data.title: Add workspace-aware defaults (docket current)
data.body:
## Goal

Make commands workspace-aware so you don't need to specify bug ID when inside a workspace.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Inside `ws-{id}` workspace, `docket show` without args shows that bug
- [ ] Inside workspace, `docket update` without ID updates that bug
- [ ] Inside workspace, `docket done` without ID completes that bug
- [ ] Inside workspace, `docket edit` without ID edits that bug
- [ ] Add `docket current` command that prints the current workspace's bug ID
- [ ] Outside workspace, commands still require explicit ID

## Context

When working in a workspace, you're always working on one bug. Having to remember and type the ID is friction. The workspace name already encodes the bug ID.
